_README: THE ONE HOME for hand-reviewed audiobook <-> library_catalog joins.
Nothing here is generated. Every row is a join a person looked at and
stood behind, and it exists because the automatic matchers on BOTH sides
correctly REFUSE it. Do not bulk-populate this file: an override that was
not individually reviewed is a guess wearing a reviewed row's clothes,
which is the exact failure the auto-matchers' refusals prevent.
Read by two consumers, one per direction:
audiobook -> library : site/library-link.js (this repo), fetched by the
book modal on site/index.html.
library -> audiobook : library_catalog/scripts/lib/cross-catalog-overrides.mjs,
which reads THIS FILE from the sibling checkout
(LC_AUDIOBOOK_ROOT) - see that module's header for
why the library side GUARDS rather than writes.
It lives in site/ because that is the one directory both consumers already
reach: the browser fetches it beside shelf_book_map.json, and the library
repo already reads site/catalog.csv from this checkout on disk.
WHAT IS CHECKED, AND WHERE - the two halves are deliberately split, because
neither repo can perform the other's check:
tests/test_cross_catalog_overrides.py (this repo) pins the SHAPE and that
every audiobookTitle exists VERBATIM in site/catalog.csv. An override
naming a book this catalogue does not hold is dead weight that renders
nothing, and it fails the suite rather than sitting here unnoticed.
library_catalog `npm run check:cross-links` pins that every libraryWorkId
EXISTS in the library's work table. That is the check that stops a dead
/work/<id> link shipping, and only that repo can take it.
FIELDS
audiobookTitle    the VERBATIM title column of site/catalog.csv. Not a
cleaned title, not a fold - the exact string, because a
curated row must name one row and never a family of
them.
libraryWorkId     library_catalog work id. The link is
https://library.heygabi.ai/work/<id>.
libraryTitle      what that work is called over there, for the link text.
libraryLabel      the part/volume designation, shown in brackets. Null
when the work needs no disambiguation.
format            the format word. ALWAYS present - the owner's
cross-catalog spec (2026-08-14) is that every entry
says the form the media is in.
why               why the automatic matchers refuse this join. Prose, for
the next person deciding whether the row still holds.
reviewedOn        when a person last confirmed this row against both
catalogues.

overrides.audiobookTitle: The Wandering Inn - The Wandering Inn, Book 1
overrides.why: One audiobook, two printed works: Book 1 is sold in print as two paperbacks. The library's mapping route withholds a fold for this title (two works cache the same audiobookTitle) and app/library_link.py tombstones the exact title for the same reason, so the automatic join stamps nothing. Both refusals are correct - one id cannot express two destinations.

overrides.audiobookTitle: The Wandering Inn - The Wandering Inn, Book 1
overrides.why: The second half of the same audiobook. See work 229's row.

overrides.audiobookTitle: Fae and Fare - The Wandering Inn, Book 2
overrides.why: Same shape as Book 1: one audiobook, two printed works.
